Subject: Elsmere Motorworks - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Elsmere Motorworks. I've reviewed the information and need to refer this to senior underwriting before proceeding.

The referral is needed due to:
- Auto class requires management review
- Total insured value of $9.2M exceeds our standard authority
- Two locations within 16 km of the coast
- High coastal concentration in our existing portfolio in this area

I'll present this internally and circle back within 3-5 business days. Given the coastal exposure and accumulation concerns, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market in parallel.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
